'''TX-94''' was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]].

==Behind the scenes==
TX-94 instructed players how to play the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']] mini-game, "Galactic Forces."
